author: Sealious Seal
title: LF people who can draw Pokemon (Garchomp and Lucario)
content:
LF people who can draw Pokemon
You don’t have to be a Pokemon-centered artist or anything, I just want artists who are willing to draw Pokemon or know how 😭 more specifically, Garchomp and Lucario.
I usually prefer more anime-esque styles and the OC is cutesy and elegant, but given the Pokemon, I can’t be picky this time around when it comes to the style ,, place your rates and samples in the comments, NO DMS!
This is the OC (credit to Miki Fleur) and she will be wearing more fashionable clothes (similar to Emma from Veil) so please be able to draw those too!
MOP: GCash, like always

author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
content:
Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. We have steady book work planned well beyond this first title: the right illustrator will have ongoing commissions for the foreseeable future.
The project: ~640 words, 14 full spreads + cover, 8.5" × 8.5" paperback. Warm, playful, family-centered, told entirely in first-person visuals.
We're after soft, expressive, cinematic storytelling; classic picture-book charm with real emotional range.
Who we're looking for: An emerging illustrator ready to earn their first picture book credit, or add a strong title to an existing portfolio. You need to draw the same characters, animals, and settings again and again, different scenes, different angles, and keep them recognizable every time. Strong sequential storytelling across full spreads.
Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones (signing / approved thumbnails & character designs / approved finished illustrations / print-ready delivery). Two shortlisted finalists each get $100 for a paid test. Future books come with paid commissions and the opportunity to negotiate ongoing royalty participation. Prominent cover and title-page credit.
Timeline: Hire by November 1, 2026; Thumbnails ~December 15; Finished art ~February 1, 2027; Print-ready ~March 1, 2027
To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing the same characters across multiple scenes and angles plus sequential pages, a sentence or two about yourself, your availability, and confirmation your work is original and human-made (no generative AI).

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES
content:
HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES
Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.
If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work.
Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required.
These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. (Yes, we're aware AI art has appeared on our channel before, and we'd love to return to using human artists full-time once the budget supports it, and this is part of that plan.)
Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability:
Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com
Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST
Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!
